pr_title: *: optimize query slow query table by avoid decode plan for each row
pr_body:
<!-- Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

PR Title Format:
1. pkg [, pkg2, pkg3]: what's changed
2. *: what's changed

-->

### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #25982

Special optimize the system table `slow_query`/`cluster_slow_query` query performance for `tidb-dashboard` to reduce query memory and time.

### Benchmark

Generate some to slow log, and each SQL length is `40960 byte`.

1. Lower the slow log threshold.
   ```sql
   set @@tidb_slow_log_threshold=0;
   ```
 
2. Use [loadgen](https://github.com/crazycs520/load) to generated load:

   ```shell
   bin/loadgen payload gen-stmt --host 172.16.5.40 --port 4019  --concurrency 50 --stmt-cnt=100 --query-len 40960
   ```
   The generated SQL is look like this:
   
   ```sql
   select * from t_gen_stmt_1 where a = 1 or b = 1 or c = 1 
   union all
   select * from t_gen_stmt_2 where a = 2 or b = 2 or c = 2 
   union all
   ...
   ...
   ...
   ```
   
   After generated about `3.6GB` slow log size, stop the `loadgen`. 

3. Enlarge the slow log threshold.
   ```sql
   set @@tidb_slow_log_threshold=3000;
   ```

4. Bench the SQL: 

```sql
SELECT Digest, Query, Conn_ID, (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(Time) + 0E0) AS timestamp, Query_time, Parse_time, 
	Compile_time, Mem_max, Process_time, Write_keys, Request_count 
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.CLUSTER_SLOW_QUERY 
WHERE Time BETWEEN FROM_UNIXTIME(1626092537) AND FROM_UNIXTIME(1626180644 ) ORDER BY Query_time ASC LIMIT 100;
```

|                      | Master | This PR |
| ---------------------| ------ | ------- |
| Query duration       | 23s    | 8s      |
| Query memory consume | 3GB    | < 30MB  |

Related TiDB memory consume metric is below:

Master:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/26020263/125459971-10eceb22-6ab4-4fa1-9a80-ad26acd5eb75.png)


This PR 

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/26020263/125460162-3805d114-8d71-4d77-a5a3-9de9f0587e51.png)


### What is changed and how it works?

By prune column and avoid `decode plan` when the query doesn't need the plan.

issue_context.title: Make the dashboard query to slow logs more lightweight
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

Refer this https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/25892, query the  `statemens summary` table maybe very slow cause by decode plan, event the query doesn't need to read the `plan`, **Which means that the decode behavior is quite time-consuming and memory-consuming compared to the user workload.**

In the recent oncall issue-3291, as obviously demonstrated in the profile below

![screenshot-2](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/15825830/124542548-26890600-de56-11eb-9a30-103473239420.png)


the slow log query consumes much memory up to approximately 11 GB or so, which will be even worser if the slow logs are more complicated. **Consequently the risk of OOM is absoulate reasonable.**

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/15825830/124541918-f856f680-de54-11eb-982e-9aea24312d38.png)

Since dashboard always shows the slow log in the folding way, user actually won't click every item to see them all, so it is possible to avoid decoding the plan too when we fetch a batch of them. Once the user click the item for more detail, let's decode the plan out by then.

According the @crazycs520 's expriment of decoding plan or not in statement-sumary-system-table, the enhancement is a blockbuster indeed. **It's confidently promising in slow-log too.**

|                      | Master | This PR |
| ---------------------| ------ | ------- |
| Query duration       | 3.4s   | 7ms     |
| Query memory consume | 500MB  | < 1MB   |

**It's confidently promising in slow-log too.**
**It's confidently promising in slow-log too.**
**It's confidently promising in slow-log too.**

review_comments: do we have some utility function that can append row according to field type?

No. 
Actually, the other system table will append all column's values into row and do prune later.
Then how about extracting this into a utility function? Seems that this can be useful for other system tables.
No, this is not suitable for other system tables. Since only `SLOW_QUERY` should parse `string` from `slow log`, but the other system table no need to do parse.
